purpose: Registry of planning micro-checkers. Stage 1 (questions) is the normal AskUserQuestion form led by the main session and has no entry here. A project may add, disable or retier entries in .ai/planning.json. Spec: docs/specs/planning-pipeline/SPEC.md

checkers.concern: Find unknowns that facts can settle, decide whether research is needed and record the executor and the reason.
Does the plan match the owner's answers: report mismatches with the intent, research that contradicts an answer, and suggestions. Report only, never rewrite the plan.
